---
title: "Examples"
---

This section is the public notebook-oriented reading surface. It maps the four
accepted workflow categories to their canonical contracts and, once real public
runs exist, will place their results and evidence beside the corresponding
example. It does not invent notebooks or results ahead of implementation.

## Workflow categories

| Category | What the public workflow will show | Current public state | Source required before evidence can appear here |
|---|---|---|---|
| Palace Electrostatic / Surface EPR | SGB Route A/B geometry, the seven Palace control sections, mesh/config/handoff, physical results, and simulation cost | Planned; no public SCGSim notebook or run yet | A public SCGSim notebook using an implemented Electrostatic backend, plus publication-authorized run receipts and results |
| Palace Eigenmode | Semantic geometry, the seven Palace control sections, eigenmode solve diagnostics, modal results, and simulation cost | Planned; no public SCGSim notebook or run yet | A public SCGSim notebook using an implemented Eigenmode backend, plus publication-authorized run receipts and results |
| PyAEDT HFSS | The accepted fourteen-phase flow for HFSS Eigenmode and Driven Modal/Terminal | Deferred; no public SCGSim notebook or run yet | A public version-locked PyAEDT notebook and publication-authorized solver evidence |
| PyAEDT Q3D / Q2D | The accepted fourteen-phase flow for capacitance and cross-section extraction | Deferred; no public SCGSim notebook or run yet | A public version-locked PyAEDT notebook and publication-authorized extraction evidence |

The canonical section names and stage ordering remain in
[Notebook UX Contracts](notebook-ux.qmd). Backend availability and planned
order remain in the [Backend Support Matrix](backend-support.qmd).

## Evidence boundary

A future example may link its public source notebook, exact source revision,
run receipt, artifacts, physical results, convergence diagnostics, cost, and
provenance only after each item exists and has publication authority. Private
consumer names, paths, dimensions, screenshots, meshes, configs, receipts,
artifacts, and unpublished results never belong on this site.
